name: open-rebellion
description: Open Rebellion sprite tracks. A: 8-direction sheets from the 87 original TACTICAL.DLL meshes (experimental-remaster review artifact). B: advisor type-302 deterministic family transform records for the faithful-HD manifest plus Scale2x review candidates. C: native fighter texture reference set. Run from the repository root: python3 ~/.claude/skills/sprite-forge/scripts/run_pipeline.py scripts/sprites/rebellion.pipeline.json --stage render-meshes. Every stage is deterministic and free; nothing here calls a paid provider.

stages.name: render-meshes
stages.description: Track A: Blender headless render of every type-301 mesh with the recovered P57B2A camera and P57B2C2A light rig; atlas-v2 sheets, provenance.json, review sheets. Run --stage render-meshes-proof first after any rig change.

stages.name: render-meshes-proof
stages.description: Track A proof family (Star Destroyer 2560/2561/2562), sub-minute; run before --stage render-meshes after any rig change.

stages.name: advisor-generate
stages.description: Track B: nearest-4x mode-P records for the 68 authored advisor frames with chain provenance and P45C gates.

stages.name: advisor-verify
stages.description: Track B: re-decode every advisor record and fail whole families atomically.

stages.name: advisor-export-alsprite-2001
stages.description: Track B tier 2 input: decode the Alliance 2001 family to mode-P PNGs for the Scale2x review candidate.

stages.name: advisor-scale2x-alsprite-2001
stages.description: Track B tier 2: palette-preserving Scale2x over the whole family (review candidate only; verify_record stays nearest-4x).

stages.name: fighter-textures
stages.description: Track C: export the 77 native type-303 fighter textures (ids 4000-4134) as mode-P PNGs on the selected battle palette.
